subject: test(multiple): switch remaining tests to standalone
decision: Decline the remaining-standalone fixture conversion after reviewing all 16 complete files and 141 hunks. Account for every module/decorator import/provider and helper-signature change, component matrix rewrite, native date-adapter preparation, private type narrowing and genuine fixture HTML/control-flow change. Preserve all 742 case modes/order and keep modern grid/listbox, experimental components, tree and stepper fixtures out of the add-on. Retain Material16 component DOM, CSS/SCSS and consumer module contracts. No compiler, DI/provider, error or runtime identity equivalence is claimed. Read-only Cyph sanity confirms existing legacy module/markup/style bindings; no consumer edit. Actual packed/native/browser/SSR/compiler/Node/RxJS/exact-peer floors and independent audit remain required.
